Definition: from G3316; to interpose (as arbiter), i.e (by implication) to ratify (as surety):--confirm.
BiblicalUsage: Mesiteuo means to interpose, to step between as arbiter, and so to confirm. Hebrews 6:17 says God, willing to show the heirs of promise the immutability of His counsel, confirmed it by an oath.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God confirmed His promise the way men confirm theirs, and then went further: He swore by Himself, because there was no greater to swear by.
